summary: VAT amount rounds half a cent down instead of up

text.description:
## Summary
The VAT amount of a net amount is rounded half a cent down, so the VAT is one cent short whenever the exact VAT ends in half a cent.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Compute the VAT of a net amount of 0.25 at a VAT rate of 22%
2. Read the VAT amount and the gross total

## Expected result
Half a cent rounds up to the next cent; amounts with no half cent are not changed.

## Actual result
The VAT amount is 0.05 and the gross total is 0.30: half a cent is rounded down.

## Environment
env: staging
